soft_failures.text: AI is moving beyond being just a tool.

synthesis.claim: The ability of AI systems to autonomously refine their alignment training signals a fundamental shift from AI being a tool built by humans to AI becoming a co-creator in its own evolution, potentially democratizing advanced AI development while simultaneously raising new questions about control.
